title: Report: Air Force Research Regarding the "Roswell Incident", July 1, 1994
doc_notes: This is an official Air Force report regarding the Roswell Incident, concluding that the event was a result of a Project Mogul balloon recovery rather than an extraterrestrial crash.

encounters.summary: Major Jesse Marcel recovered debris from a ranch near Roswell, which he initially claimed was a flying disc, but was later identified by the Air Force as a Project Mogul balloon radar target.
encounters.quote: The Intelligence Officer of the 509th Bomb Group... had recovered a flying disc

encounters.summary: Rancher W.W. Brazel reported finding debris on his property in June 1947, which he later described as rubber, tinfoil, paper, and sticks.
encounters.quote: came upon a large area of bright wreckage made up of rubber strips, tinfoil, a rather tough paper, and sticks
